pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Use 3V3 so OUT stays under 3.3 V. Some boards have a second GND pin

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: AC wave centred on VCC/2; set the amplitude with the trimmer. To an ADC pin (prefer ADC1: GPIO 32 to 39)

pins.name: L
pins.notes: MAINS input! Only a qualified person connects this. Never to the ESP32

pins.name: N
pins.notes: MAINS input! Only a qualified person connects this. Never to the ESP32
